$comment: One entry per language. Adding a pair = adding an entry here, no code changes (D16). Vendor-specific fields are filled in by the task that adds that adapter. outputChecks (G15): markers are common function words for a deterministic language check; assistantPatterns and refusalPatterns are lower-case substrings that mark an output as not a translation. Model-written and unverified. realtimeTranslate (G17): gpt-realtime-translate can output this language; en and es were checked live 2026-10-14. vi (T4.1): text model-written and not checked by a Vietnamese speaker; realtimeTranslate false until checked live.
